evals.prompt: В американском свидетельстве о натурализации 1920-х у прадеда место рождения записано как «Kaminetz, Russia». Где это и в каком архиве искать его метрику 1885 года?
evals.expected_output: Records the name verbatim with its source. Builds variants (Kaminetz, Kamenets, Kamenetz, Kamieniec, Каменец (Russian), Камянець (Ukrainian)) and checks them in JewishGen Communities and the Gazetteer (Daitch-Mokotoff), finding that there are several places with the same name (Kamenets-Podolsky, Kamenets-Litovsk, Kamenka and others). Asks for or looks for features from other family documents (guberniya, neighbouring towns, fellow travellers, a relative back home named in the manifest) and screens the candidates by uezd and features, without choosing silently. For the chosen candidate gives the jurisdiction in 1885 (guberniya, uezd) and the archive (for example, for Kamenets-Podolsky: the archive of the Khmelnytskyi oblast, the catalogue of metrical books, Commons). Fills in the place card from assets/place-card.md with the candidates and the confidence level.

evals.prompt: Бабушка рассказывала, что её дед родился в 1866 году в Рени. Почему я не могу найти его метрику в русских метрических книгах?
evals.expected_output: Explains that southern Bessarabia (Izmail, Kiliya, Bolgrad, Cahul, Reni) belonged in 1856–1878 to the Principality of Moldavia / Romania, so a Russian metrical record of 1866 cannot exist; registration was Romanian, and such records have almost all been lost or are not digitized: the absence is a property of the source. Suggests checking where the family was in the Russian period (before 1856 and after 1878: ANRM, FamilySearch films, the Izmail archive, a communal institution of the Izmail city council outside the Odesa oblast archive system since 12.11.2003) and indirect sources giving the year and place of birth. Reflects this in the place card, in the jurisdiction-by-year table.

evals.prompt: В ревизской сказке написано, что семья приписана к селу Новосёлки, а в семье говорили про хутор возле Новосёлок, которого сейчас нет. Как его найти и понять, в каком уезде он был?
evals.expected_output: Warns that there are many villages with this name and a match proves nothing until the uezd and volost are checked; takes the uezd and guberniya from the heading of the revision list. Looks for candidates in the Lists of Populated Places (Spiski naselyonnykh mest) of the relevant guberniya and in volost directories. For the vanished khutor: determines the locality (neighbouring villages, river, parish), finds the surviving neighbours on a modern map, overlays the three-verst map, Strelbitsky maps and survey maps (or WIG and Mapster for Polish lands), checks the number of households and the volost in the Lists; notes that khutors and folwarks often do not appear as separate localities. Records the maps with year, scale and coordinates in the place card.
